description:
AgentSpaces for LangChain4j applications on any JVM host: a plain-Java
    runtime that builds a peer from the same agentspaces.* configuration the
    Spring Boot starter and the Micronaut library read, the framework-neutral
    tool catalogue, and the fleet on LangChain4j's extension points (tools,
    listeners, chat memory, the model service, embeddings, usage). A
    standalone project on the published AgentSpaces libraries.
